meals.name: One-Pot Creamy Chicken and Rice Bake
meals.description: Tender chicken thighs nestled in fluffy rice with sweet peas and carrots, all simmered in a comforting savoury stock. Everything cooks in one pot for minimal washing up.

meals.name: Chicken and Sweetcorn Rice Soup
meals.description: A warming, gently spiced soup with shredded chicken, sweetcorn and rice, finished with a squeeze of lemon. Perfect for chasing away the chill on a wet evening.

meals.name: Smoky Chicken and Pepper Rice Skillet
meals.description: Spanish-inspired chicken, rice and sweet peppers cooked in a smoky paprika tomato sauce. Rich, colourful and satisfying, all made in one frying pan.

meals.name: One-Pot Lemon Chicken and Rice
meals.description: Tender chicken thighs simmered with fluffy rice, sweet carrots and peas in a gently lemony stock. All cooked in one pot for a comforting, low-fuss supper.

meals.name: Creamy Chicken and Rice Soup
meals.description: A thick, velvety soup with shredded chicken, rice and soft vegetables. Perfect for warming up on a wet, chilly evening with some crusty bread.

meals.name: Baked Chicken and Rice Casserole with Broccoli and Cheddar
meals.description: Chicken, rice and broccoli baked in a cheesy sauce until bubbling and golden on top. A hearty, oven-baked dish that needs very little attention.

meals.name: One-Pot Creamy Chicken and Rice Bake
meals.description: Tender chicken thighs and fluffy rice simmered together in a creamy, savoury stock with sweet peas and carrots. Pure comfort in a single pot.

meals.name: Chicken and Sweetcorn Rice Soup
meals.description: A warming, brothy soup with shredded chicken, rice and sweetcorn, finished with a squeeze of lemon. Ideal for a damp evening.

meals.name: Chicken Tikka-Style Traybake with Rice
meals.description: Chicken thighs marinated in yoghurt and mild spices, roasted with red onion and peppers, then served over fluffy rice. Gently spiced and cosy.

meals.name: Butternut Squash and Cashew Mac 'n' Cheese
meals.description: Silky roasted butternut squash and cashew sauce with nutritional yeast gives all the cheesy, comforting richness of a classic mac and cheese, with no dairy at all. Perfect for a cold evening.

meals.name: Baked Creamy Potato and Carrot Mac with Crispy Crumb Topping
meals.description: A cosy baked macaroni with a velvety sauce made from potato, carrot and soya milk, finished with a golden, crunchy breadcrumb topping. Dairy-free comfort in a dish.

meals.name: One-Pot Creamy Chicken and Sweetcorn Mac
meals.description: Everything cooks together on the hob in one pan: tender chicken, sweetcorn and macaroni in a creamy, savoury coconut milk sauce with a cheesy kick from nutritional yeast. Warming and easy to wash up.

meals.name: Creamy Cashew Mac and Cheese with Peas
meals.description: A silky dairy-free cheese sauce made from blended cashews, nutritional yeast and garlic, tossed through tender macaroni with sweet peas. Pure comfort for a cold evening.

meals.name: Baked Butternut Squash Mac with Crispy Crumb Topping
meals.description: Macaroni baked in a velvety butternut squash and garlic sauce with a savoury nutritional yeast flavour, finished with a golden, crunchy breadcrumb topping. Warming and cosy.

meals.name: One-Pot Cheesy Beef Chilli Mac
meals.description: Macaroni simmered with beef mince, sweet peppers and tomatoes in a smoky sauce, then stirred through with melty dairy-free cheese. A hearty, one-pan supper.

meals.name: Creamy Cashew and Carrot Mac and Cheese
meals.description: Silky, golden dairy-free sauce made from blended cashews, carrot and nutritional yeast, tossed through tender macaroni for a cosy, cheesy-tasting bowl.

meals.name: Baked Broccoli Mac and Cheese with Crispy Crumb Topping
meals.description: A bubbling oven-baked mac with a rich olive oil and oat milk white sauce, savoury nutritional yeast, tender broccoli and a golden crunchy breadcrumb crust.

meals.name: One-Pot Creamy White Bean Mac with Spinach
meals.description: A cosy one-pot pasta where blended cannellini beans create a velvety, cheesy-tasting sauce, finished with smoky paprika and wilted spinach.

meals.name: Extra-Cheesy Beef Lasagne
meals.description: A classic family lasagne with a rich, mild beef and tomato ragù, a silky cheese sauce and a golden mozzarella and Cheddar topping. Made with gluten-free lasagne sheets and thickened with cornflour, so everyone can tuck in.

meals.name: Creamy Chicken, Spinach and Sweetcorn White Lasagne
meals.description: A tomato-free lasagne layered with tender chicken, sweet sweetcorn and soft spinach in a gooey Cheddar sauce. Mild, creamy and topped with bubbling mozzarella, with gluten-free sheets and a cornflour sauce.

meals.name: One-Pan Cheesy Lasagne Pasta
meals.description: All the flavours of lasagne in one frying pan with no layering needed. Gluten-free pasta simmers in a hidden-veg turkey tomato sauce, then gets stirred through with cream cheese and topped with melted cheese.

meals.name: Ultimate Cheesy Beef Lasagne (Gluten-Free)
meals.description: Rich beef and tomato ragù layered with gluten-free lasagne sheets and a creamy cheddar sauce, finished with a bubbling mozzarella top. Hidden grated carrot adds sweetness the kids won't spot.

meals.name: Cheesy Spinach and Ricotta Lasagne Roll-Ups
meals.description: Gluten-free lasagne sheets rolled around creamy ricotta, mild spinach and mozzarella, nestled in tomato sauce and baked until golden. Fun, easy-to-eat spirals that kids can help assemble.

meals.name: Hidden Veg Chicken and Potato Cheesy Lasagne Bake
meals.description: A naturally gluten-free twist where thin potato slices replace pasta sheets, layered with a chicken and courgette tomato sauce and a creamy cheddar topping. Comforting, cheesy and packed with vegetables.

meals.name: Ultimate Cheesy Beef Lasagne (Gluten-Free)
meals.description: Layers of rich, mild beef ragù and a silky cheddar white sauce, made with gluten-free lasagne sheets and topped with a golden bubbling crust of mozzarella.

meals.name: Cheesy Sweet Potato and Spinach Lasagne
meals.description: A naturally gluten-free veggie lasagne with soft sweet potato layers, creamy ricotta and spinach, a simple tomato sauce and plenty of melted mozzarella on top.

meals.name: Cheesy Turkey and Courgette Lasagne Pasta Bake
meals.description: All the flavours of lasagne in an easy bake: gluten-free penne tossed in a hidden-veg turkey tomato sauce with cream cheese, then smothered in melted cheddar and mozzarella.

meals.name: Chicken Satay Noodle Stir-Fry with Sunflower Seed Sauce
meals.description: Tender strips of chicken and crunchy vegetables tossed with flat rice noodles in a creamy, nut-free satay-style sauce made with sunflower seed butter and coconut milk. Mild and family-friendly.

meals.name: Prawn and Pak Choi Satay Egg Noodles
meals.description: Juicy prawns, courgette and pak choi with springy egg noodles, coated in a silky tahini and coconut satay sauce. Nut-free, mild and quick to make.

meals.name: Crispy Tofu and Broccoli Satay Noodles
meals.description: Golden pan-fried tofu with tenderstem broccoli and sugar snap peas in a rich, creamy sunflower seed satay sauce over wheat noodles. A hearty vegetarian dinner that is gently flavoured for little ones.

meals.name: Chicken Satay Noodle Stir-Fry with Sunflower Seed Sauce
meals.description: Tender chicken and crunchy vegetables tossed with egg noodles in a rich, creamy, nut-free satay sauce made with sunflower seed butter and coconut milk. Mild and family-friendly.

meals.name: Prawn and Rice Noodle Satay Stir-Fry
meals.description: Juicy prawns, courgette, pak choi and beansprouts with silky rice noodles in a creamy coconut and sunflower seed satay sauce, finished with fresh coriander and lime.

meals.name: Crispy Tofu and Vegetable Satay Udon
meals.description: Golden pan-fried tofu with mushrooms, sweetcorn, red pepper and spinach, coated in thick udon noodles and a rich, mild, nut-free satay sauce. A tasty vegetarian option.

meals.name: Chicken Satay Noodle Stir-Fry
meals.description: Tender chicken, crunchy vegetables and rice noodles tossed in a rich, creamy satay-style sauce made with sunflower seed butter, so it is completely nut-free. Mild and family-friendly.

meals.name: Creamy Satay Prawn Noodles with Pak Choi
meals.description: Juicy prawns and egg noodles coated in a silky coconut and sunflower seed satay sauce with a gentle hint of sweetness. Quick enough for a busy weeknight.

meals.name: Crispy Tofu Satay Udon Stir-Fry
meals.description: Golden pan-fried tofu with chewy udon noodles, mushrooms and vegetables in a rich, savoury satay sauce. A hearty vegetarian dinner that is mild and nut-free.

meals.name: Salmon Poke Bowl with Sesame-Free Ginger-Soy Dressing
meals.description: Cubes of fresh salmon on sushi rice with crisp cucumber, creamy avocado and edamame, finished with a zingy ginger-soy-lime dressing and a sprinkle of toasted sunflower seeds in place of sesame.

meals.name: Seared Ginger-Honey Salmon Rice Bowl
meals.description: Pan-seared salmon glazed in a sticky ginger, garlic and soy sauce, served over fluffy rice with tender broccoli and sweet red pepper for a cooked take on the poke bowl.

meals.name: Smoked Salmon Soba Poke Salad
meals.description: A cool, refreshing noodle bowl with buckwheat soba, smoked salmon, crunchy radish, cucumber and edamame, tossed in a punchy ginger-lime dressing with fresh coriander.

meals.name: Classic Salmon Poke Bowl with Sesame-Free Ginger Dressing
meals.description: Cubes of silky raw salmon on sushi rice with creamy avocado, crisp cucumber and edamame, finished with a zesty ginger-soy dressing. A touch of peanut butter gives it the nutty richness without any sesame.

meals.name: Baked Ginger-Soy Salmon Rice Bowl
meals.description: Salmon fillets baked with a sticky honey, ginger and garlic glaze, served warm over rice with broccoli, edamame and crunchy red cabbage. A cooked, cosy take on the poke bowl.

meals.name: Cold Soba Noodle Poke Salad with Ginger-Peanut Dressing
meals.description: Chilled buckwheat noodles tossed with crisp cucumber and carrot, topped with seared salmon and a creamy ginger-lime peanut dressing. Fresh, light and sesame-free.

meals.name: Classic Salmon Poke Bowl with Ginger-Soy Dressing
meals.description: Cubes of fresh salmon on warm sushi rice with crisp cucumber, creamy avocado and edamame, finished with a zesty ginger-soy-lime dressing and toasted sunflower seeds for a nutty crunch.

meals.name: Seared Salmon Rice Bowl with Ginger-Peanut Dressing
meals.description: Crisp-skinned seared salmon over fluffy rice with red cabbage, radish and avocado, drizzled with a rich, nutty ginger-peanut dressing that gives the creamy depth of a classic sesame-ginger sauce.

meals.name: Salmon Poke Noodle Bowl with Ginger-Lime Dressing
meals.description: Chilled soba noodles tossed with a zingy ginger-soy dressing and topped with marinated salmon, ribbons of cucumber and carrot, spring onion and strips of nori.

meals.name: Summer Fish and Pea Paella
meals.description: A classic hob-cooked paella with flaky white fish, sweet peppers and peas in saffron-scented rice, finished with a squeeze of lemon and plenty of parsley.

meals.name: Oven-Baked Salmon and Courgette Paella
meals.description: Rice baked in the oven with juicy cherry tomatoes, courgette and rich salmon fillets on top, so you can relax outside while it cooks.

meals.name: Quick Smoked Haddock and Sweetcorn Paella
meals.description: A speedy, smoky paella-style rice with smoked haddock, sweetcorn and sweet peppers, brightened with spring onion and lemon.

meals.name: Summer Fish Paella with Saffron and Peas
meals.description: A golden saffron rice cooked in the pan with flaky cod and salmon, sweet red pepper and peas, finished with a squeeze of lemon. Shellfish-free but full of that classic paella flavour.

meals.name: Oven-Baked Lemon Salmon Paella with Courgette
meals.description: A relaxed, mostly hands-off paella baked in the oven, with turmeric-tinted rice, tender courgette, green beans and juicy cherry tomatoes topped with flakes of lemony salmon.

meals.name: Fish Fideuà: Spanish Noodle Paella with Haddock
meals.description: A paella-style dish made with toasted thin noodles instead of rice, simmered in a smoky tomato stock with haddock and sweet peppers, then served with a garlicky mayonnaise.

meals.name: Summer Fish Paella with Peas and Saffron
meals.description: A classic-style paella made with flaky cod and salmon, sweet red pepper and juicy tomato, all scented with saffron and smoked paprika. Finish it with a squeeze of lemon and serve straight from the pan on a sunny weekend.

meals.name: Paprika Salmon and Rice Paella Traybake
meals.description: An easy oven-baked take on paella: rice cooks in a savoury stock with courgette and cherry tomatoes, topped with smoked paprika salmon fillets. Minimal stirring and plenty of flavour, so it suits a relaxed weekend.

meals.name: Chilled Tuna Paella-Style Rice Salad
meals.description: A cool, make-ahead summer salad inspired by paella, with saffron-tinted rice, tuna, sweet peppers, peas and olives in a zesty lemon dressing. Perfect for a picnic or a garden lunch on a hot day.

meals.name: Vegan Carbonara with Smoky Mushrooms
meals.description: Silky spaghetti coated in a creamy cashew and nutritional yeast sauce, topped with crisp smoked mushrooms and plenty of black pepper for a rich, indulgent date night classic.

meals.name: Creamy Vegan Mac and Cheese with Crunchy Breadcrumbs
meals.description: Pasta shells smothered in a velvety, cheesy sauce of potato, carrot and nutritional yeast, finished with golden garlicky breadcrumbs. Pure comfort for a cosy night in.

meals.name: Creamy Garlic Mushroom and Spinach Tagliatelle
meals.description: Ribbons of tagliatelle tossed in a luscious garlicky cream sauce made with vegan cream cheese and white wine-style tang, with golden mushrooms and wilted spinach for a restaurant-style dinner at home.

meals.name: Vegan Mushroom Carbonara
meals.description: Silky spaghetti coated in a creamy cashew and oat cream sauce with smoky golden mushrooms, nutritional yeast for a cheesy depth and plenty of black pepper.

meals.name: Creamy Vegan Mac and Cheese with Garlic Breadcrumbs
meals.description: Comforting macaroni in a velvety sauce of potato, carrot and nutritional yeast, topped with crisp golden garlic breadcrumbs for a cosy, indulgent dinner for two.

meals.name: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato and Spinach Penne
meals.description: Penne tossed in a rich, blushing tomato cream made with silken tofu and nutritional yeast, with wilted spinach and a hint of basil for a restaurant-style date night dish.

meals.name: Vegan Cashew Carbonara with Smoked Tofu
meals.description: Silky pasta coated in a creamy cashew and nutritional yeast sauce, with crisp smoked tofu standing in for the bacon and plenty of black pepper.

meals.name: Creamy Mushroom and Spinach Penne with Vegan Parmesan
meals.description: Penne in a rich, garlicky oat cream sauce with golden mushrooms and wilted spinach, finished with a nutty, cheesy vegan parmesan.

meals.name: Baked Vegan Mac and Cheese with Crunchy Crumb
meals.description: Comforting macaroni in a velvety, cheesy sauce of potato, carrot and nutritional yeast, topped with golden garlicky breadcrumbs and baked until bubbling.

meals.name: Õhukesed pannkoogid moosiga
meals.description: Õhukesed kuldse servaga pannkoogid, mis on pooleks voltimisel pehmed ja ulatuslikult moosiga kaetud. Mineraalvesi teeb taigna ilma munata kergeks ja õhuliseks.

meals.name: Kefiiripannkoogid maasikamoosiga
meals.description: Paksud kohevad pannkoogid kerge hapukasvõitu maitsega, mis sobib hästi magusa maasikamoosiga. Kefiir ja küpsetuspulber teevad need munata ka pehmeks.

meals.name: Kaera-banaanipannkoogid
meals.description: Pehmed kaerahelvestest pannkoogid, mida seob küps banaan, serveeritud mustikamoosiga. Kaneel annab neile soojad hommikused toonid.

meals.name: Õhukesed pannkoogid moosiga
meals.description: Õrnad kuldsed pannkoogid, mis on rullitud ümber magusa maasika- või vaarikamoosi. Taigen on munavaba, aga pannil saab see ikkagi pitsilise serva.

meals.name: Banaanipannkoogid moosiga
meals.description: Paksud, kohevad pannkoogid, kus banaan hoiab taigna koos ja annab pehme magususe. Peale kallatakse rohkelt moosi.

meals.name: Õuna-kaerapannkoogid
meals.description: Kaerahelvestest ja riivitud õunast pannkoogid, mis on pealt kuldsed ja seest pehmed. Kaneel ja moos teevad need pühapäevaseks.

meals.name: Õhukesed pannkoogid moosiga
meals.description: Õrnad kuldse äärega pannkoogid, mis rullid kokku maasikamoosiga. Taigen saab kerge ja siidine ilma munata.

meals.name: Kefiiripannkoogid moosiga
meals.description: Pehmed ja kohevad pannkoogid, mille taigen saab kefiirist. Peale lased lusikatäie leotud moosi.

meals.name: Banaani-kaerapannkoogid
meals.description: Mahlased pannkoogid, kus banaan hoiab taigna koos ja annab loomuliku magususe. Moos ja kaneel teevad need pühapäevaseks.

meals.name: Tofusushikauss
meals.description: Kuldseks praetud tofu, kleepuv riis, kreemjas avokaado ja krõmpsuv kurk noriribadega. Riis maitsestatakse äädikaga, nagu päris sushis.

meals.name: Kanaga riisipallid
meals.description: Pehmed onigiri-stiilis riisipallid mahlase teriyaki-kana ja majoneesiga, mähitud krõbeda noriga. Kana saab pannil kiiresti läikiva glasuuri.

meals.name: Munarull riisiga
meals.description: Pehme omletirull, mis on täidetud riisi, avokaado ja kurgiga ning lõigatud sushirulli moodi viiludeks. Sojakastmega kastes tuleb sool ja sügavus.

meals.name: Tofu-avokaadokauss
meals.description: Kuldselt praetud tofu, kreemjas avokaado ja krõmpsuv kurk leotatud riisil. Noriribad ja seesam toovad sushi maitse.

meals.name: Munarullid köögiviljadega
meals.description: Pehme munaomlett, porgand ja kurk riisi ja nori sisse keeratud. Lõikad rullid ribadeks ja kastad sojakastmesse.

meals.name: Teriyaki kanakauss
meals.description: Mahlane teriyaki kanafilee riisil koos värske kurgi, porgandi ja majoneesitilkadega. Noriribad lisavad sushi-tunde.

meals.name: Tofu sushikauss
meals.description: Kuldseks praetud tofu, kreemjas avokaado ja krõmpsuv kurk sushiriisi peal. Nori ribad ja seesam annavad sushi maitse.

meals.name: Kimbap-stiilis munarull
meals.description: Nori-leht täidetud riisi, pehme omleti, spinati ja porgandiga. Rull lõigatakse viiludeks ja serveeritakse sojakastmega.

meals.name: Teriyaki kanaga riisipallid
meals.description: Kleepuvast riisist pallid, mille sees on läikiv teriyaki kana, ümber nori leht. Kõrvale värske kurk.

meals.name: Ahjulõhe sidrunikartulitega
meals.description: Mahlane lõhefilee küüslaugu ja tilliga, kõrval kuldsed sidrunikartulid. Kõik valmib ühel plaadil.

meals.name: Kalavorm kartuli ja koorega
meals.description: Kreemjas ahjuvorm õrna tursa, kartuliviilude ja sulanud juustuga. Pealt kuldne ja krõbe.

meals.name: Ahjulasanje spinati ja ricottaga
meals.description: Kihiline lasanje spinati, ricotta ja tomatikastmega. Pealt sulanud mozzarella kuldse koorikuga.

meals.name: Ahjulõhe sidrunikartulitega
meals.description: Mahlane lõhe küüslaugu ja tilliga, kõrval kuldsed sidrunikartulid ja ahjus röstitud spargel. Kõik valmib ühes vormis ja läheb otse lauda.

meals.name: Spinati-ricotta lasanje
meals.description: Kihiline lasanje kreemja ricotta, spinati ja tomatikastmega, pealt kuldse sulajuustukoorikuga. Ahjus muutub see pidulikuks suureks vormiroaks.

meals.name: Täidetud paprika tuunikalaga
meals.description: Magusad ahjupaprikad riisi, tuunikala ja fetajuustu täidisega. Pealt sulanud mozzarella ja küpsetatud tomatikaste.

meals.name: Ahjulõhe sidrunivõiga
meals.description: Mahlane lõhefilee sidruni-küüslaugu-võiga, kuldsete kartulite ja rohelise sparglipeenraga. Kõik küpseb ühel ahjuplaadil, nii et laud on kiiresti kaetud.

meals.name: Spinati-rikota lasanje
meals.description: Kreemjas spinati-rikota täidis, rikkalik tomatikaste ja kuldne sulatatud mozzarella pealmine kiht. Ahjus valminud lasanje sobib hästi suurele pühapäevalauale.

meals.name: Ahjupaprika riisi ja fetaga
meals.description: Värvilised paprikad on täidetud ürdise riisi, tomati ja soolase fetajuustuga. Ahjus hautuvad need pehmeks ja magusaks.

meals.name: Kana-wokk riisinuudlitega
meals.description: Mahlane kanafilee ja krõmpsuvad köögiviljad kleepuvas ingveri-laimikastmes. Wokis kiirelt kuldseks praetud, nagu Aasia restoranis.

meals.name: Kana pad thai
meals.description: Pehmed riisinuudlid, kana ja muna magushapus kastmes, peal purustatud maapähklid. Laimipigistus toob värskuse.

meals.name: Singapuri karrinuudlid kanaga
meals.description: Kuldsed munanuudlid kanaga, kapsa ja porgandiga kerges karri-kookoskastmes. Wokis kuumalt läbi segatud, lõhnavad hästi.

meals.name: Kana-wokk munanuudlitega
meals.description: Mahlased kanatükid ja krõmpsuvad köögiviljad munanuudlitega, kõik kuumal pannil kiiresti läbi kuldistatud. Kaste on mee, laimi ja kalakastmega magusahapu.

meals.name: Pad Thai kanaga
meals.description: Pehmed riisinuudlid, kuldne muna ja kanatükid laimise tamarindi-sarnase kastmega. Peale tulevad krõbedad maapähklid ja idud.

meals.name: Karrinuudlid kanaga
meals.description: Õhukesed riisivermišellid, kanatükid ja värvilised köögiviljad kollases kookose-karrikastmes. Kõik valmib ühel suurel pannil.

meals.name: Kana-wokk munanuudlitega
meals.description: Mahlased kanatükid, krõmpsuv kapsas ja paprika ning läikivad nuudlid ingveri-küüslaugukastmes. Kõik valmib kuumal pannil paari minutiga.

meals.name: Kana pad thai
meals.description: Riisinuudlid, kanatükid ja pehme muna maapähklite ning laimiga. Magushapu kaste kattub nuudlitel kuumal pannil.

meals.name: Karrinuudlid kanaga
meals.description: Kuldne kookoskarrikaste ümbritseb nuudleid, kanatükke ja värvilisi köögivilju. Kreemjas ja pehme maitsega õhtusöök.

meals.name: Soe kartulisalat suitsutofuga
meals.description: Pehmed soojad kartulid, suitsutofu kuubikud ja kreemjas taimne hapukoor tillise hapukurgi-sibula kastmes. Maitseb nagu vanaema kartulisalat, aga suitsukala asemel on suitsutofu.

meals.name: Soe kartulisalat suitsuporganditega
meals.description: Suitsupaprikaga röstitud porgandiribad asendavad suitsukala, soe kartul imab endasse sidruniselt jogurtikastme. Murulauk toob värskuse.

meals.name: Kartuli-oasalat suitsupaprikaga
meals.description: Soe kartul ja pehmed valged oad hapukoorekastmes, suitsupaprika annab sellele suitsuse maitse. Hapukurk ja petersell teevad salati krõmpsuvaks ja värskeks.

meals.name: Soe kartulisalat suitsutofuga
meals.description: Soe kartul, suitsutatud tofu ja kreemjas jogurtikaste hapukurgi ja tilliga. Maitseb nagu vanaema köögis, aga ilma kalata.

meals.name: Kartulisalat suitsuporgandi ja kašukastmega
meals.description: Soe kartul ja õrnalt suitsused porgandiribad, mis meenutavad suitsukala. Peale kreemjas kašukaste ja murulauk.

meals.name: Ahjukartulisalat seentega
meals.description: Kuldsed ahjukartulid ja suitsupaprikas hautatud austerservikud, kõik jogurtikastmes sinepi ja tilliga. Seened annavad suitsukala moodi sügava maitse.

meals.name: Soe kartulisalat suitsutofuga
meals.description: Soe kartul hapukoore, hapukurgi ja kuldse suitsutofuga, täpselt nagu vanaema salat, aga taimne. Tofu praetakse pannil krõbedaks.

meals.name: Kartulisalat suitsuporganditega
meals.description: Soe kartulisalat kreemja hapukoorekastme ja ahjus röstitud suitsupaprika-porganditega. Porgand toob suitsukala maitse.

meals.name: Kartulisalat kikerherne ja noriga
meals.description: Soe kartul kapparite, krõbedate kikerhernete ja noriga, mis annab salatile mereanni maitse. Hapukoorekaste seob kõik kokku.

meals.name: Läätsebolognese spagettidega
meals.description: Samet-pehme tomatikaste punaste läätsede ja riivitud porgandiga, mis tõmbab keetes kenasti pehmeks. Peale läheb kuldne riivjuust.

meals.name: Kookosläätsekarri riisiga
meals.description: Kreemjas ja mahe karri punaste läätsede, porgandi ja spinatiga. Kookospiim teeb selle pehme, nii et see sobib ka väiksematele suudele.

meals.name: Läätse-juustutortillad
meals.description: Krõbedad kuldsed tortillad sulajuustu, maisi ja vürtsikate läätsedega. Pannil küpsetatud ja hapukoorega serveeritud.

meals.name: Läätsepasta tomatikastmes
meals.description: Pehme punase läätse ja porgandi tomatikaste kleepub spagettide külge nagu bolognese. Riivjuust peal sulab kuumas pastas kreemjaks.

meals.name: Kookosläätsekarri riisiga
meals.description: Kreemjas ja mahe läätsekarri kookospiima ja porgandiga, kõrvale kohev riis. Magusakas maitse sobib lastele hästi.

meals.name: Läätse-juustuquesadillad
meals.description: Krõbedad tortillad, mille sees on sulajuust, läätsed, mais ja paprika. Hapukoorekaste teeb need pehmeks ja mahedaks.

meals.name: Läätsebolognese spagettidega
meals.description: Kreemjas punase läätse ja tomati kaste keeb pehmeks ning katab spagetid ühtlaselt. Peale sulab juust.

meals.name: Läätsetortillad juustuga
meals.description: Krõbedad tortillad pehme läätse-paprikatäidise ja sulanud juustuga. Käsitsi söömiseks sobib hästi.

meals.name: Porgandi-läätsesupp
meals.description: Siidine oranž supp punase läätse, porgandi ja kartuliga. Kookospiim teeb selle pehme ja kreemja.
